{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABZlUzdQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhDL3F8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 55, "title": "Implement SH-2 MOV load pipeline timing and IF/MA contention", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17.

At `e3b17e1e22f68232b6dfb68c1687b736ec490380`, ordinary memory-to-register MOV instructions execute their operand reads directly in `Cpu::execute`. `execution_states` supplies one base state and `LoadPipeline` adds a destination dependency penalty. Explicit operand-phase scheduling, instruction-alignment splits and successor overlap are implemented for multiplier-related instructions, but ordinary MOV loads are excluded from that path.

Consequently, the existing implementation does not establish the documented load MA/WB boundaries or distinguish the cached IF/MA contention of otherwise equivalent aligned and word-offset load kernels. This matters for ordinary polling loops, shared-memory communication and device reads, beyond the existing demos.

## Expected outcome

Implement the ordinary memory-to-GPR MOV load pipeline on both SH-2s, integrating operand timing and successor scheduling with the existing transaction journal and bus arbiter.

The primary contract is the Hitachi [SH-1/SH-2 Programming Manual](https://antime.kapsi.fi/sega/files/h12p0.pdf), September 1996:

- §§7.2–7.3, printed pp.169–171: stage sharing, stretched slots and EX-to-EX execution intervals.
- §§7.4.1–7.4.3, printed pp.172–175, figures7.6–7.8: MA-first contention, real IF versus retained `if`, including cached instruction alignment.
- §7.5, printed pp.175–176, figure7.9: load dependencies and documented exceptions.
- §7.7.1, printed pp.184–186, especially the memory-load pipeline: five-stage loads, distinct from register transfers and stores.

A real IF conflicting with MA splits the slot; retained `if` permits sharing. Operand latency stretches the relevant slot. Derive the combined dependency and contention timing from stage diagrams rather than adding unrelated penalties mechanically.

Required precise pipeline evidence covers warmed instruction-cache execution, with resident-cache, cache-array, on-chip peripheral and scheduled external operands. Preserve uncached fetch/refill execution and document remaining speculative-fetch limitations. Ordinary store-pipeline completion and other instruction families remain separate mandatory #17 work.

## Context and reproduction

Inspect `src/cpu.rs:379–406` and `src/cpu.rs:452–515`, `src/cpu/timing.rs`, `src/cpu/multiplier.rs:40–50`, `src/bus/transactions.rs`, and `Machine::issue_cpu` in `src/lib.rs`.

A focused reproduction should compare warmed-cache kernels placing the same MOV load at addresses `4n` and `4n+2`, followed by an independent instruction. Use a resident one-cycle operand to isolate cached IF/MA contention. Also change an operand around its independently derived MA completion boundary to expose premature sampling.

Existing `tests/sh2_timing.rs`, `tests/sh2_bus_pipeline.rs` and multiplier fixtures provide reusable integration infrastructure, but do not establish ordinary-load stage conformance. `docs/sh2-multiplier.md:144–145` explicitly leaves general pipeline completion outstanding.

The current main SHA was rechecked and matches the supplied snapshot. There are no open task Issues. The supplied main build observation is in progress, with no conclusion. `docs/validation-issue-53.md` records passing implementation-time regressions; those results are historical evidence, not proof of this missing behavior. No complete suite was rerun during this read-only planning pass.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record an independent stage/clock table before changing production behavior. Identify the exact manual edition, sections and diagrams, distinguish SH-2 from SH-1, and reconcile applicable corrections. Evidence-backed corrections to this AI-authored task must update the Issue with primary references and rationale; they require no human confirmation.
- [ ] Implement every ordinary MOV memory-load addressing form: indirect, postincrement, displacement, R0-indexed, GBR-relative and PC-relative, with applicable byte/word/long widths. Preserve sign extension, register aliases, auto-update and delay-slot PC-relative semantics. Register-only MOV/MOVA/MOVT must not acquire a memory-load phase.
- [ ] Add literal native timing vectors for both CPUs and both instruction alignments. Include independent and dependent successors, repeated loads, documented dependency exceptions, and multi-clock operands. Assert operand acquisition/completion and successor timing, not merely final registers or a total instruction count. Demonstrate distinguishing failures against inherited behavior.
- [ ] Exercise resident data-cache reads, mapped cache RAM, CPU-local peripheral reads, cache misses and uncached external operands. Verify changed operands before/at/after derived sample boundaries, retained completed reads and no duplicate MMIO/FIFO effects during replay. State deterministic equal-edge conventions separately from hardware-specified timing.
- [ ] Add board-level integration vectors with a competing peer CPU, on-chip DMAC and SCU DMA. Assert relevant bus grants, sampled values and CPU-local stalls without inventing a new arbitration policy. Preserve existing buffered-write, TAS, refresh and device-ownership behavior.
- [ ] Verify pending-load cancellation and retained completed effects through applicable CPU/system reset paths, plus interrupt and address-error regressions. Compare fixed-horizon traces across advancement chunks 1/3/17/10000 and with/without passive debugger inspection.
- [ ] Provide an original MIT-licensed synthetic guest, source, reproducible builder and hashes. Both SH-2s execute load kernels and compute arithmetic/readback and FRT records. Native Machine and production browser Wasm execute identical bytes, including alignment changes, changed input operands, a dependency-removal control and repeated cold boots. Expected records must come from authored operands and primary-derived timelines, never emulator captures or host-written results.
- [ ] Preserve existing tests and the substantive assertions for Star Collector, Prism Courier and Hardware Lab. Any necessary timing-golden correction must include an independent derivation and retain the original regression purpose; do not weaken assertions to accommodate the implementation.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native and Wasm Clippy with warnings denied, existing fixture/media reproducibility checks, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, and the complete extended `npm run test:browser` under `/saturn-rust/`, without required skips. Register the new fixture/browser coverage in existing CI.
- [ ] Update architecture, conformance and validation records with exact implementation/test/specification links, actual results and remaining deviations. Report this as partial #17 progress. Remaining CPU/peripheral, bus/reset/arbitration, SCU/DSP, video/audio, CD/media/HLE, SMPC and comprehensive integration requirements stay mandatory. Genuine BIOS and commercial-game compatibility remain unverified.

## Optional validation

Additional randomized instruction sequences checked against an independently authored stage model. No personal firmware, commercial media, physical console, human approval or live Pages inspection is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
